# Under GOEXPERIMENT=logosstack a goroutine starts at the stack size that its
# go statement learned, and a go statement with no history keeps the global
# size. The runtime tests that check this skip unless the experiment is on, so
# this script turns it on and fails if any of them skips or does not run.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosstack
go test -v -count=1 -run '^(TestLogosStackSiteStartsAtLearnedSize|TestLogosStackSpawnDoesNotAllocate|TestLogosStackStartBoundedByMaxStack|TestLogosStackSurvivesCollection|TestLogosStackFirstBuffersSurviveStartSizes)$' runtime
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosStackSiteStartsAtLearnedSize'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosStackSpawnDoesNotAllocate'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosStackStartBoundedByMaxStack'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosStackSurvivesCollection'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosStackFirstBuffersSurviveStartSizes'
! stdout 'SKIP'
stdout '^ok\s+runtime'
! stderr 'no tests to run'
! stdout 'no tests to run'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/stacklearned

go 1.27
